realBugs.details: screen-passkey-enroll/declined has no button that navigates to chooser. User reaches a dead-end after declining enrollment.
screen-passkey-enroll/suppressed (Don't ask again confirmed) has no button to return to chooser/main app. Dead-end.
Save new password button on screen-new-password does not navigate to screen-reset-success. Confirmed in both reset-happy and password-forgot flows.
'Edit' button on screen-reset-sent (Send the reset to a different email) does not navigate back to screen-forgot-password.
